name: vistula-of-bonding
description: A bonding capacity summary from your job list and the single and aggregate limits your surety gave you: bonded backlog against the aggregate limit, jobs over the single-job limit, bonded jobs forecast at a loss, and whether the bonded bids you are chasing fit in what is left. Drafts the summary for your surety broker. Never requests a bond or sends financials; not surety advice.
